formula: a=argmin_j (lam**j * d mod N); b=argmin_j (beta**j * Px mod p); ties->min j; S=I(a;b) bits; Delta=I_real-mean I(a;b_pi); NO match-rate/Pearson/argmax; NO doubling/offsets
domains: d mod N; Px in F_p; a,b in {0,1,2}
score_definition: mutual information I(a;b) with log2 over 3x3 table
trivial_exclusion_justification: Orbit labels of d and Px are not fixed by curve equation; wrong Px attachment should destroy I(a;b) if any pairing signal exists.
